title: App store submission deadline (Android + iOS)
text:
Sam Okafor submits the Pairly beta builds to Google Play and the App Store.

Must be in the builds:
- New 4-screen onboarding
- Final app icon (overlapping speech bubbles) and brand colors
- Fix for push notifications on Android 15

Store screenshots and description: Priya Raman and Wop testwell.
App review can take up to 5 days, so this date protects the Nov 2 launch.
